audit.why: FAV at 4/10 with a 5/10 carry threat is right for a tank with no lane damage against 850-range poke. The packet flags '33.33% win rate vs a 7/7 Ziggs chart', but the packet sample is 3 games and the chart on disk is not 7/7 — it already hands Sejuani parity from Level 6 on (Skill, Skill, Skill), which is the honest shape. Mirror recorded no point-2 correction, so I left the chart alone rather than introduce a disagreement.

Level 6 as the pivot is right: Mega Inferno Bomb is 120/95/70s over 5000 units and Glacial Prison is 120/105/90s over 1300 — hers is a fight tool, yours is a map tool, which is exactly what phases[4] and spikes[1] say. Mirror recorded the same 5000/120-95-70 framing from her side.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three things: Arctic Assault is called a fifteen-second cooldown when it is 18s at rank 1; the page never states that Permafrost only stuns at max Frost stacks; and the whole 'minefield stops her approach' framing is backwards, because Frost Armor grants immunity to slows.
audit.why: Fury of the North: out of combat Sejuani carries Frost Armor, which grants Armor, MR and immunity to slows. Hexplosive Minefield is Ziggs's only slow, so her first approach is not slowed at all — Bouncing Bomb chip is what puts her in combat and strips the armour. Permafrost (1.5s, 560 range) stuns only a champion at maximum Frost stacks, and Winter's Wrath (600 range) is what applies them. Arctic Assault is 18/16.5/15/13.5/12 and stops on the first champion hit.
audit.corrected: Chip her with Q first to strip Frost Armor, then the mines actually slow. Stay past 600 and Winter's Wrath never stacks Frost, so Permafrost never stuns. Arctic Assault is 18s at rank 1 and stops on the first champion it hits.
